_comment: Canonical source of truth for Sibyl on-chain deployments. Update this file when (re)deploying or committing a new replay; README and tooling reference it.

SibylLedger._comment: Multi-market ledger (per-(agent,market) reputation, market registry, convictionIndex). Superseded the single-market ledger 0x847a6c5a32F5Ed69c43a82f46a84Df75f9B9Bd2A (storage layout changed, so it was redeployed, not migrated).

SibylVault._comment: ERC-4626 strategy vault — built + tested (148 forge tests) but NOT deployed (Option A scope = ledger + markets + reputation only). The API /vault endpoints fall back to an artifact/snapshot shape while address is null.

latestReplay._comment: Per-(agent,market) Brier scores committed on-chain. Same agent has independent reputation per market (e.g. momentum_v1: MNT 153565 vs ETH 201210 ppm). datasetHash is the SHA-256 of the deterministic 2-market frozen dataset.

latestConsensus._comment: Recorded ConsensusReached events, one per market (computeConsensus is also a live on-chain view). Different consensus per market from independent reputations + signals.

erc8004.note: Each Sibyl agent minted an ERC-8004 identity NFT (reused across the ledger redeploy; the NFTs persist). Full records in deployments/agent-identities.json.
